concepts.name: Energy — How Things Work
concepts.definition: Central learning focus developed by the chapter 'Energy — How Things Work'.
concepts.evidence: In Grades 3 and 4, students have engaged with local toys like (spinners and paper boats) to understand how they work.

concepts.name: Evidence and reasoning
concepts.definition: Using chapter information to support an explanation or answer.
concepts.evidence: They have also learned about how things are made by exploring the processes of bricks, paper, etc.

concepts.name: Application
concepts.definition: Using the chapter idea in a new but related situation.
concepts.evidence: While making things with locally available materials students learn useful methods of sustainable development, including refuse, reduce, reuse, repurpose and recycle (the 5 R s) so that they can make responsible decisions.
